title: The Kwa Junda Confrontation
description: Enter Arthur Champion's administrative station at Kwa Junda, present the legendary parable of the Hen and Chicks, and evade the guards to escape back to the hinterland.

objectives.description: Approach Administrator Arthur Champion at the administrative veranda.
Deliver the challenge and release the mother hen and chicks into the compound.
Sprint through the administrative compound and escape through the South Exit Gate!

reward_text: Mekatilili and Wanje have openly defied Arthur Champion and escaped into the sacred hills! Chapter 2 completed.
